extractedItems.title: Giving advice before a shot
extractedItems.question: If a golfer asks, 'Which club should I use?' and someone answers, what happens?

choices.text: Nothing, this is always allowed.
Both players get 2 penalty strokes.
The player asking or receiving advice gets 2 penalty strokes.
Only the person giving advice gets a penalty stroke.

extractedItems.explanation: A player asking for or giving advice before a shot will get 2 penalty strokes. The person who is given advice does not get penalised unless they asked for it.

choices.text: After searching for 3 minutes.
Immediately after the first shot, before walking forward, and announce it is provisional.
Only if your ball is in a penalty area.
After someone tells you to play another ball.

extractedItems.explanation: You must announce and play a provisional ball before moving forward if you think the original ball could be lost or out of bounds.

reviewedItems.title: Giving advice before a shot

choices.text: Nothing, this is always allowed.
Both the player asking and the one answering get 2 penalty strokes.
The player who asks for or receives advice, and the one who gives it, each get 2 penalty strokes.

reviewedItems.explanation: If a player asks for or gives advice about how to play a shot (such as club selection), both the player who asks/receives and the one giving advice get a two-stroke penalty in stroke play.

reviewedItems.title: How and when to play a provisional ball
reviewedItems.question: If you think your ball might be lost outside a penalty area or out of bounds, what should you do before going forward to search?

choices.text: Search first, then play a provisional ball after 3 minutes.
Announce that you will play a provisional ball, then play it immediately before searching.
Only play a provisional ball if the ball is in a penalty area.
Play a provisional ball only if told to by another player.

reviewedItems.explanation: You must announce and play your provisional ball before going forward to search for your original ball if you think it might be lost or out of bounds (not in a penalty area).

No, you are not allowed to play a provisional ball in this case.
Only if your ball is in long grass.
Yes, but only after searching for 5 minutes.
